name: Reverse Clip Menu
description: Fullscreen menu opened by a round toggle. An image grid scatters radially outward while the menu list is revealed by a clip-path expanding from the center, with an optional looping background video.
contents: Round hamburger toggle button in the top right
Grid of cover images behind a large two-line title
Fullscreen menu list with numbered items and hover underline
Optional background video inside the menu
behavior: Opening scatters cover images outward from the center with random rotation and fades the title
Menu panel expands from a center point by clip-path
Closing reverses the timeline with an elastic ease, or faster if interrupted mid-open
Escape key closes the menu and returns focus to the toggle
Loading line shows until GSAP and images are ready
editableByProps: Colors of background, text, accent, overlay and toggle
Title lines and menu item labels
Cover images, grid size and image positions
Scatter distance, delays and close easing

needsCodeEdit.change: Menu item links (hrefs or click handlers)

fixed: Root is full-bleed at 100dvh and clips its content
Menu panel and loader use fixed positioning layers inside the root
